description: This PHP source file defines the PasswordStrengthService class, which provides methods for enforcing password policies, validating passwords, generating reset codes, and managing enforced password reset requests within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: PasswordStrengthService
classes.description: Service class for managing password strength policies, validation, generation of enforcement codes, and handling password reset requests within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEnforcePasswordDao
methods.description: Lazy instantiates and returns the EnforcePasswordDao object used for database operations related to enforced password requests.

methods.name: getMinLength
methods.description: Retrieves the configured minimum password length.

methods.name: getMaxLength
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum allowed password length.

methods.name: getMinNoOfLowercaseLetters
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum number of lowercase letters required in the password.

methods.name: getMinNoOfUppercaseLetters
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum number of uppercase letters required in the password.

methods.name: getMinNoOfNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum number of numeric characters in the password.

methods.name: getMinNoOfSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum number of special characters required in the password.

methods.name: getIsSpacesAllowed
methods.description: Indicates whether spaces are allowed in the password based on configuration.

methods.name: getDefaultPasswordStrength
methods.description: Retrieves the default password strength setting.

methods.name: checkMinPasswordLength
methods.description: Checks if the password meets the minimum length requirement.

methods.name: checkMaxPasswordLength
methods.description: Checks if the password exceeds the maximum length.

methods.name: checkMinLowercaseLetters
methods.description: Checks if the password contains the minimum required lowercase letters.

methods.name: checkMinUppercaseLetters
methods.description: Checks if the password contains the minimum required uppercase letters.

methods.name: checkMinNumbersInPassword
methods.description: Checks if the password contains the minimum required numeric characters.

methods.name: checkMinSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Checks if the password contains the minimum required special characters.

methods.name: checkSpacesInPassword
methods.description: Checks if the password contains spaces when they are not allowed.

methods.name: checkRequiredDefaultPasswordStrength
methods.description: Checks if the password's strength meets the default setting.

methods.name: checkPasswordPolicies
methods.description: Validates password against all configured policies and returns messages describing violations.

methods.name: isValidPassword
methods.description: Determines if the provided password adheres to all required policies.

methods.name: generateEnforcePasswordResetCode
methods.description: Generates a secure random code for password reset enforcement.

methods.name: logPasswordEnforceRequest
methods.description: Creates and logs a password enforcement request, returning the reset code.

methods.name: validateUrl
methods.description: Validates a reset code URL for expiration and correctness.

methods.name: isResetCodeTimeOut
methods.description: Checks if the reset code has expired based on configured timeout.

methods.name: getUserNameByResetCode
methods.description: Retrieves the username associated with a reset code.

methods.name: validateUser
methods.description: Validates the user object, checking for termination records.

methods.name: saveEnforcedPassword
methods.description: Saves a new enforced password for the user, handling transactional integrity.
